notes:
Summary:
- AdPulse is an adtech personalization platform that needs sub-100ms end-to-end inference for decisioning at the ad-server hop. Primary workload: reranking + short chat-like personalization prompts for mobile web and in-app.
- Very cost sensitive at scale: current budget target ~ $0.20 CPM added inference cost (implies strong per-token cost pressure).
Key asks for Redwood:
- Deterministic perf benchmark: want p50/p90/p95 token latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and cost-per-1M-tokens for candidate models (Llama-3 8B variants, Mistral-7B, 4-bit quantized runs). Run both single-request and burst load profiles.
- Optimize interest: concrete batching/caching/quantization recommendations that preserve top-1 rerank accuracy within 1-2% of baseline. Need guidance on dynamic batching thresholds (latency vs throughput tradeoffs), prefix/KV cache patterns for repeated user prefixes, and recommended quantization knobs (int8 vs 4-bit with per-channel).
- Deployment: prefer dedicated pools in us-east + failover in us-west; VPC peering required. Also evaluating hosted API for initial smoke tests but production will be Dedicated or Private.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 is a must, SSO/SAML integration required, KMS for key management. Data retention: ad identifiers removed after 7 days, request to log anonymized traces only.
Recent quotes from CTO (Ben Zhao): "If we can't get p95 under 120ms with <2x cost growth we won't move to dedicated. We need repeatable numbers not hand-wavy demos."
POC notes + results so far:
- 2026-02-28 internal baseline: in-house PyTorch quantized Llama-3 8B @ 4-bit produced p95 ~ 280ms on A100 for 1-token generation under concurrency 200 (not acceptable). Cost estimate ~$0.002/token.
- 2026-03-02 Redwood demo: streamed generation, observed p50 75ms, p95 210ms on a Redwood-hosted config (single-region). Team asked for more aggressive batching + KV caching tests to bring p95 < 120ms.
- Redwood asked to run a benchmark harness against 3 model configs and provide suggested batching window, max batch size, and cache TTL defaults. Also asked for quantization profile notes and accuracy delta table.
Actionable next steps (short):
- Redwood to run perf harness (seeding dataset + 10k real request traces) and return p50/p90/p95 + cost estimates for 3 configs. (Jordan to schedule cluster run).
- Legal to finish data residency + retention checklist. (Aisha to coordinate).
- Engineering to evaluate 4-bit vs int8 quantization impact on rerank AUC (dev team will supply eval set).
